scope: Existing mapmaker prototype (vtt/static/mapmaker), contract rd-mapmaker v1. UI-verified cells cite journeys; source-only cells say so.

create.how: Datei > Neue Karte … > Startkarte | Leere Karte (J02)

read.how: Datei > Öffnen (.rdmap.json) (J15); browser draft restore dialog (J25)

update.how: header 'Kartentitel' = meta.title + download filename (J12); no resize, no sea colour

delete.how: no delete/discard-draft command; New/Open overwrite the single IndexedDB draft slot (J24, J25)

entities.constraints: file ≤50 MB, sides 256–4096, ≤32 layers, ≤8 raster, raster area ≤32 Mpx, ≤2000 items, title ≤80 (document.js:6-21)

entities.entity: World / hierarchy / sub-map navigation / collaboration / multi-DM ownership
entities.constraints: Not implemented and not promised by the prototype; no IDs linking places to child maps; single local user.

entities.entity: Raster layer (Land / Gelände / Flüsse & Wege / custom)

create.limits: inserted directly above the ACTIVE layer (app.js:396-397) — can land above Symbole (F8)

read.how: layer list with kind subtitle, active row highlight, 'Malt auf: …' in tool pane

update.how: rename via pencil (dblclick broken, F9), ↑/↓ reorder, opacity slider, visibility eye, coast toggle (J23, J17)

delete.how: trash, no confirm, toast 'Strg+Z holt sie zurück' (J16)

undo.how: all layer commands incl. visibility are undo steps

create.limits: only 'Land' auto-routes to a coast layer; other materials paint on whatever layer is active (F3)

read.how: visual only; strokes are pixels, not selectable entities; material identity is not stored

update.how: overpaint only; no per-stroke edit, move or recolour

delete.how: Radierer on active layer (J22); residue at same size; erasing on Land reshapes coast by design

undo.how: per stroke 'Pinselstrich' / 'Radieren'; budget 60 steps / 64 MB (history.js:5-6, source)

entities.constraints: Raster pixel edits are NOT independently selectable vector entities; hidden layer blocks painting with toast (J17).

update.how: same row controls as raster (no coast)

create.how: Stempel > palette > click, or scatter drag (J06)
create.limits: no palette search; palette scroll area 265–414 px (F7)

read.how: click with Auswählen (topmost visible wins); no object list; covered items reachable only by moving the cover (J10)

update.how: drag move, inspector size/rotation/flip (J10, 026.out); no asset swap, no nudge feedback, no lock

delete.how: Entf or 'Auswahl löschen' (J09), no feedback toast (F14)

entities.constraints: hidden layer: not selectable, not placeable (J17); size 4–512; no link to places (F6)

entities.entity: Text label (Ortsart 'Nur Beschriftung', e.g. painted map title)

create.how: Ort tool, Stil Reich/Region/…, Ortsart 'Nur Beschriftung' (J12)

read.how: canvas click only; NOT listed in Orte tab

update.how: inspector: name ≤80, style, colour, size 8–200, rotation, pin; drag move

undo.how: edits batched as 'Eigenschaften ändern' per selection session

create.how: Ort tool with Ortsart Stadt/Dorf/Burg/Hafen/Ruine/Landmarke (J07); Orte tab '+ Ort setzen' button visible (not exercised)

read.how: Orte tab lists name, kind, lore; click centres + selects (J08); JSON place.kind/lore (J15)

update.how: inspector incl. kind and lore ≤500 (hard maxlength, F12)

entities.constraints: no link to settlement stamp, no parent region, no child map, no stable user-visible ID (F6)

cross_cutting.multi_select_group: no (Shift-click single select, no marquee) — later advanced scope
cross_cutting.lock: no — later advanced scope; useful once backgrounds/frames exist
cross_cutting.object_list_for_stamps_labels: no — recommended before atlas hierarchy (needed to reach covered items and to link places)
cross_cutting.pick_under_pointer_vs_selected_layer: pick under pointer only (topmost visible across all layers; selecting switches active layer, app.js:553-556). GIMP 3.0 move tool distinguishes 'pick a layer' vs 'move the active layer' — no equivalent mode here.
cross_cutting.save_vs_export: separated and explained in export dialog (J14) — aligned with GIMP 3.0 save (.xcf) vs export split
cross_cutting.data_safety: New warns; Open does not (F1); single draft slot (F5)
